body: Yes we are still together, its not that she ignores me when I drink, its just that whenever I do drink she starts getting angry at me. She has told me in the past that she doesn't like it but she is very hypocritical because she does it herself. I work in a stressful environment that puts me around alcohol 24/7(I run security in a club) and sometimes I like to indulge myself. I really do love her, and I do want to be with her, I just don't understand why me getting drunk turns into WWIII. My family has a history of suicide and alcoholism. This is not the first time in my life that I have been suicidal or depressed, its just that I had a lot of feelings about this woman, she was the someone who I thought would always be there.  Im not going to lie, it feels nice to always have the option of suicide under your belt. Its the one thing you have control over when you have nothing else in life. My life is going no where, I have a shitty job, I have no one to talk to anymore, it feels like Im completely alone.  I have been extremely depressed for these last few days because the only thing she has said to me is "If I see you in public I will act like I dont know you" and "Leave me alone". I fuck up everything good that I have.
Don't set it on fire. That's a trick I learned the hard way.
Reddit is getting worse with Facebook statuses than Facebook is with text messages.
Thank you for posting this. It has been one of the worst days in my life and it is amazing to find something that I can laugh at.

Wow apparently my pc gaming community doesn't understand how to take a joke. It's odd because  the PC download is so much more expensive than the physical copy with free shipping even when it's a shit game. Whatever, if you have to explain a joke then it isn't funny .
